objective: Convert between exponential and logarithmic statements and determine the domain of a logarithmic expression.
assessmentPolicy: Thirty-five named practice variants cover the planned subtopics. The common/natural variant includes independent numerical evaluation, and the operating-window audit retains attained inverse endpoints. Four mixed critical checkpoint items sample the four families. All four selected items must pass without assistance; one checkpoint does not claim to test every variant.
